note: Hand-written from Google's Chirp 3 HD phoneme table for the locale where one exists (fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT) and from PHOIBLE otherwise; first draft 2026-10-16. Symbols are the phonemic set an entry may use; the display and the engine input share it.
conventions: Standard French of France. Stress is not phonemic; put the primary stress mark on the last syllable that is not a schwa. Final schwa is dropped unless it is pronounced in ordinary speech. Liaison consonants are not written on the headword.
